tools.name: ifso_version
tools.description: Which IFSO build is running, the chain id (Robinhood Chain mainnet is 4663), the address of every contract it uses (payments, conditions, outcome resolver, USDG) and the fee constants in base units and USDG. The same answer as GET /v1/version. Check these addresses before approving anything in a wal

tools.name: ifso_get_payment
tools.description: The current state of one if-so payment, read from the chain: status (OPEN, MET, RELEASED, RETURNED, VOIDED, CANCELLED), amount in USDG, sender, recipient or claim link key, expiry and the condition that unlocks it. Payment ids are large whole numbers (up to 78 digits); pass them as a string.

tools.name: ifso_list_conditions
tools.description: The kinds of condition an if-so payment can wait for (a date, a price at or by a deadline, a football league result, a Polymarket question, both people tapping OK, or a named referee), with example commands, the price tickers, the timing rules and the amount limits read from the contract. tools.description: One v2 if-so payment by its payment address: the terms, the asset and amount, whether the money has arrived, and the live state on the chain (not opened yet, OPEN, MET, RELEASED, RETURNED or CANCELLED).
